description.value: Goodlow Store is a small convenience shop serving the rural Goodlow community along Cecil Lake Road in the Peace River region of northeastern British Columbia. As one of the only resupply points in this remote stretch of Northern BC, it would be a significant stop for any touring cyclist passing through the area. The store's existence is documented in a Wikimedia Commons photograph, confirming a physical roadside presence.

No OSM amenity tags (wheelchair, internet_access, etc.) are present, so nearly all amenities are unknown.
